description: Search the fractio.pl catalog of fractional executives in Poland. Filter by role, free-text query (skills, industry, name; Polish or English keywords), city and maximum hourly rate. Returns name, headline, location, work mode, availability, hourly rate (PLN net) and the profile URL.

city.description: City in Poland; remote experts are listed with 'Zdalnie'.

max_hourly_rate.description: Upper limit in PLN net per hour. Experts without a published rate are kept.
